about: Demo Lab art assets, written by Tools/Art/build_all.py. Engine frame: left-handed, +Y up, the front of an asset faces -Z (as imported characters do); units are centimetres. size_m is the mesh's bounds in metres (x, y, z); bounds_cm its min/max. A part is a separate mesh: place it at the asset's position plus offset_cm (turned with the asset); 'axis' is what it moves along or turns about, in the asset's frame. Every mesh's sections name their materials, so a Render component needs no material slots (except the SteamDummy: pick its look in slot 0).

grids.L2: 400 cm: walls 400 wide x 500 tall, floors and ceilings 400 x 400
grids.L3: catwalks 400 cm straight, 22.5-degree arcs of radius 700-850 cm

terrain.note: paint layer 0-3 = vertex colour R G B A; set the Terrain component's UV Tile Size to 100 (1 m) so each layer repeats at its own size (2, 2, 4, 2 m)

particles.SteamVent: Content/Particles/SteamVent.nmparticle -- a vent's column and wisps, up +Y (L1 vents, L3)
particles.SteamJet: Content/Particles/SteamJet.nmparticle -- a leaking joint's bursts along +Y every 2.5 s
particles.SparksLoop: Content/Particles/SparksLoop.nmparticle -- spark bursts that bounce at the entity's height, a flash
particles.ReactorArcs: Content/Particles/ReactorArcs.nmparticle -- four lightning beams (Beam End, or the component's Beam Target) and spark showers; put it at ReactorCore's dome
particles.SprinklerSpray: Content/Particles/SprinklerSpray.nmparticle -- droplets and mist along +Y: turn the entity 180 about X under a ceiling head; drops die 450 cm below
particles.DustMotes: Content/Particles/DustMotes.nmparticle -- motes in a 6 x 4 x 6 m box (light shafts)
